descriptionChirho: The compound proper name שְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי referring to a Persian official mentioned in Ezra 5-6 who, together with Tattenai, investigated the rebuilding of the Jerusalem temple. The three clusters merely reflect the morphological parsing of the compound name: S144376 captures the first element 'Shetar' (Arabic شَتَر, Korean 셔르, Swahili Shethar), S144377 the conjunctive 'and-Shetar-Boznay' form (Spanish y-Setar-Boznai, Hindi और-शतरबोजनै), and S144378 the second element 'Boznay' (Arabic بُوزْناي, Korean 보즈나이). All refer to the same individual person; splitting is an artifact of tokenization.
